evidence_source.endpoint: Experimental hydration free energy in water at 298 K
evidence_source.interval_construction: Split-conformal, calibrated on the validation partition

threshold.meaning: A candidate is advanced when its hydration free energy is more negative than the threshold.
threshold.how_this_value_was_chosen: Declared for teaching before any evidence was read. It is not a scientific cut-off, and nothing in this repository establishes that -5.0 kcal/mol separates useful from useless compounds. The arithmetic below does not depend on the value.

decision_rule.advance: the whole interval lies below the threshold: prediction + radius < threshold
decision_rule.reject: the whole interval lies above the threshold: prediction - radius > threshold
decision_rule.abstain: the interval straddles the threshold: absolute difference between prediction and threshold is at most the radius
decision_rule.abstention_band_width: twice the conformal radius, on the prediction axis
decision_rule.why_abstention_is_explicit: A point prediction always yields a decision. Requiring the interval to clear the threshold makes the undecidable region visible instead of silently resolving it in favour of whichever side the point estimate fell on.

prediction_grid.what_this_grid_is: A declared arithmetic grid on the prediction axis, used to count how much of a fixed decision range each model can decide. It is not a sample of compounds and no compound is represented by any point on it.

selection_between_models.interval_criterion: test coverage closest to nominal from above, then narrowest band
selection_between_models.why_both_are_declared: A threshold decision consumes an interval, not a point estimate. Declaring both criteria before reading the numbers is what makes the disagreement between them reportable rather than a choice made after the fact.

what_a_decision_here_does_not_mean: An advance outcome means the calibrated interval cleared a declared threshold on a retrospective benchmark. It is not a prediction of experimental success, not a claim about any specific compound, and not evidence that the threshold is the right one.
